# Adapter event fixtures

`v1.json` holds three deliberately synthetic envelope-only samples: a weekly
status, a risk escalation, and a plan change.  They prove that the 001 adapter
acceptance examples are configurable Semantic Pack event types and that event
records remain reference-only.

The fixture is **not** a real email export, departmental policy, authorization,
manual gold set, recall corpus, or ROI evidence.  It contains no bodies,
attachments, account identifiers, real senders, or locators.  `001/T025` stays
open until an authorized owner supplies a separately governed quality corpus.
